env_text:
# Vyomi: GCP
# GCS rides the simulator endpoint.
STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:9000
# Separate gRPC emulator container, NOT the simulator port.
PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085
# Separate gRPC emulator container, NOT the simulator port.
FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080
# Use your active space's project id if it differs.
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=cloudlearn
notes: On the Max tier (Multipass VM) replace the host with the VM IP for :8085/:8080 if localhost isn't bridged.
Secret Manager and Cloud KMS have no Google emulator: use the REST/HttpJson transport against https://127.0.0.1:9443 (caddy) and trust its certificate.
gcloud command adapters are partial; prefer client libraries.

help: Simulated gcloud will point at local Google-style endpoints.
Commands currently translate to compute, storage, sql, pubsub, firestore, functions, api gateway, VPC, and IAM routes.
cli.notes: gcloud command-shape adapters are partially implemented and expanding toward full provider coverage.
